measurement_scope: CUDA Event elapsed time around unchecked CUDA calls with preallocated Gather outputs
bandwidth_definition: Logical useful Key/Value bytes read and written per call; metadata traffic is excluded

variant_definitions.v0: Scalar-per-token baseline: one thread loops over all Key and Value elements for one token.
variant_definitions.v1: Fine-grained coalesced implementation: adjacent threads process adjacent elements of one token.
variant_definitions.v2: Vectorized implementation: one thread moves eight contiguous FP16 values as one aligned 16-byte uint4 vector, with a scalar tail path.
variant_definitions.v3: Thread-layout implementation built on V2: the same 16-byte vector movement is retained, while warps and lane groups are mapped to tokens according to the number of vector chunks.

comparison_interpretations.v1_vs_v0: Combined benefit of fine-grained thread parallelism and coalesced access mapping.
comparison_interpretations.v2_vs_v1: Incremental benefit of 16-byte vector chunking, fewer active threads, address calculations, and memory instructions.
comparison_interpretations.v3_vs_v2: Incremental benefit of changing only the warp, lane-group, and token mapping while retaining V2 vector movement.
comparison_interpretations.v2_vs_v0: Cumulative benefit from the scalar-per-token baseline to the V2 vectorized implementation.
comparison_interpretations.v3_vs_v0: Cumulative benefit from the scalar-per-token baseline to the V3 thread-layout implementation.
